game_concept: A racing platformer set in The Kingdom – Mill Stream, a stream-side windmill: the baker's apprentice must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Copy Cat: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when thieves strike.
theme: The Kingdom – Mill Stream: a stream-side windmill
core_gameplay_loop: In Mill Stream, repeat each round: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when thieves strike. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the baker's apprentice ahead. Then check the b value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the royal vault by solving code steps involving b that move the baker's apprentice forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the royal vault first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 4 (applied tier): Copy Cat
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Copy Cat' (Week 1 slot 10), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Mill Stream'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Mill Stream.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
